exposure: human gut microbiome dynamics (diversity, microbial abundances, strain composition, metabolic composition, metabolic pathway abundance, alpha-diversity)
inflammation-favoring organisms, gene functions, serum and stool metabolites
cohort: A cohort of 33 infants genetically predisposed to Type 1 diabetes (T1D).
finding: A marked drop in gut microbiome alpha-diversity was observed in T1D progressors between seroconversion and T1D diagnosis, accompanied by spikes in inflammation-favoring organisms, gene functions, and specific metabolites.
